main_text.p: כרב Syr. Aravit.Fut.cum Nomine verbali, ܟܪܒ, Quòd in spe decet Aratorem ut aret, 1. ad Cor. 9.10.
כרובא Ch.& Sy. Cherub, Cherubinus.Pl. כרובין, כרוביא, Syr. ܟܪܘܒܐ.
כרובת סוסיא Ch. Clitellæ, Ephippia equorum: Alii Phaleræ.Respondet Heb. מצלורת Tintinnabula, Zachar.14.20.
כרנא כרנא Chald. Tributum, census, Thren. 1. 1. Ecclef. 2.8.
כרדא Chal. Pallium, amiculum, 2.Sam.6.14. Plur. כרדין 2. Sam. 13.18.
כרדיתין כרדיטין Chald. Placentæ, Liba, Jerem. 7.18. & 44. 19.
כרז Aphel הכריז & אכרז Chald. & Syr. Proclamare, promulgare: prædicare, concionari. Affine est Gre. κηρύσσω & κηρύσσω. Ethpehal Syr. Fut. ܢܬܟܪܙ Prædicabitur, Matth. 24.14. & 26.13.
כרוזא Chald. ܟܪܘܙܐ Syr. Præco: Concionator, κῆρυξ, Act.15.21. 1.ad Tim.2.7.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are printed in their own scripts; some vowel points and superscript marks in the Syriac and Hebrew lines are reproduced only approximately. The catchword at the foot is כרזובא as printed.
